gate: scripts/verify_manuscript_numbers.py — exits non-zero on any failure

checks.1_value_equality: every 4-dp literal must EQUAL a ledger value; presence is not equality
checks.2_sample_and_K: every accuracy in a table row names its sample and decode budget. WAS DEAD CODE when first shipped — computed but never wired into the status or the output — while this file claimed it was enforced. Now wired and VERIFIED LIVE against a probe document that violates only this rule.
checks.3_paired_discordance: every paired claim carries its discordance counts

exception_classes.derived: computed from stored counts; each member recomputed by hand before the class was allowed
exception_classes.prior_work: a number from a cited paper, absent from our ledger by construction

remaining_failures_are_cut_list: the 6 unmatched values in results_cvpr.md are the certification result (directive section 7: cut entirely) and the superseded 137/73 stratified table (relocated to Appendix S). The gate flags them because the paper will no longer cite those checkpoints. Clearing them is a CUT performed at manuscript assembly, not a fix.

indexer_defects_found_in_my_own_checker.sign: a stored diff of -0.5935 appears as '0.5935' in prose; index both signs. 4 false flags.
indexer_defects_found_in_my_own_checker.prose_fields: numbers live inside string fields too; indexing only numeric JSON missed 4 more.
indexer_defects_found_in_my_own_checker.truncated_output: I reported REPORT.md clean from a tail-piped summary when it had 4 unmatched. Read a gate's verdict from a fresh run, never from a pipe tail.
indexer_defects_found_in_my_own_checker.derived_overreach: every member of the derived class was recomputed by hand before the pattern was accepted, so the exception cannot hide a real defect

real_defect_found: a quantization claim quoted two p-values with no discordance counts although the counts were stored; corrected to 'gained 11 lost 1, p = 0.0063; gained 6 lost 0, p = 0.0312'
not_checked: figure axis values are not traced by script; that would need figures to emit their plotted series to a sidecar, which is not built. The fabricated-parameter defect is prevented by convention.

dead_check_defect.what: check_sample_and_k ran and was assigned to bk, but status was computed from bv and bp only and bk was never printed
dead_check_defect.consequence: the check could neither fail a document nor appear in output, so 'the gate enforces three checks' was false
dead_check_defect.fix: wired into status and output; proven live with a single-rule probe that fails with exit 1
dead_check_defect.detector_narrowing: a first version flagged arXiv ids, p-values and correction notes as accuracies — 20 false positives around 4 real ones — so the matcher was narrowed to an indented label with a trailing 4-dp value
dead_check_defect.lesson: a gate must be tested against a deliberate violation of EACH rule it claims to enforce; otherwise 'the gate passes' is untestable
